display_long_description:
Block Craft Racing is a voxel-style, arcade kart racer built for Meta Quest. Race blocky karts through three vibrant worlds – sunny beach, icy tundra, and fiery lava – all rendered in charming low-poly, block-style visuals. Collect coins to upgrade and unlock dozens of toy cars, and master drift boosts and tricks on wildly customizable tracks. With simple pick-up-and-play controls and progressively challenging time-trial cups, every player can enjoy Block Craft Racing’s fast-paced fun.

🚀 [CALL TO ACTION: Race now! Jump into the driver’s seat and blast off!] Our physics-based karting engine delivers satisfying drift mechanics and speed boosts. Swerve around corners and launch over ramps: try the Ice Drift Challenge or conquer a volcano loop in the Lava Speedway. With each victory you’ll earn coins to upgrade wheels, engines and skins – personalize your ride and show off at the finish line!

🏁 Multiple Modes: Play solo in Time Trial, Cup Racing, and Track Builder modes. (Note: single-player only.) Use the in-game editor to craft your own stunt tracks from modular pieces, then race them right away. Place loops, ramps, and wall-rides anywhere: if you can imagine it, you can drive it! Save and replay your creations or challenge yourself on the built-in courses.

🎮 Kid-Friendly Arcade Action: Block Craft Racing features cartoonish block graphics (think LEGO-like scenery, without any branded names). It’s accessible to families and fun-loving gamers alike.
